     step of a larger issue). A PR with no issue link is closed automatically.
     每个 PR 都必须关联 issue：写 `Closes #N`，只完成一部分写 `Related to #N`。

## Why / 为什么

<!-- One or two sentences, starting with the reason. The reader should know what
     changes for them. 先写原因，一两句话，让读者知道对他们有什么变化。 -->

## What the issue asks, and what this PR does / issue 的要求与本 PR 的完成情况

| The issue asks for / issue 要求 | Done in this PR / 本 PR 是否完成 |
| --- | --- |
|  | Done / Not done |

<!-- List every item from the issue. An item marked "Not done" stays open for a
     follow-up PR; a PR that covers a small part of the issue says `Related to`,
     not `Closes`. 逐条列出 issue 的要求；没做的写 Not done，只完成一小部分时用 `Related to`。 -->

## Before and after / 改前改后

<!-- Any change a reader can see: paste a before and an after screenshot at the
     same viewport (for CLI output, paste the before and after text). Say in one
     line why the after is easier to read. No before and after, no review.
     读者能看到的改动必须贴同一视口的改前改后截图（CLI 输出贴改前改后的文本），
     并用一句话说明为什么改后更好读。没有改前改后不审。 -->

## Four questions (human contributors only) / 四个问题（仅限人类贡献者）

<!-- Answer these yourself. An answer written by your agent does not count.
     请自己回答，agent 代写不算。 -->

1. What outcome do you really want?
2. What is the highest-leverage variable that determines it?
3. Will this work move that variable, or just keep you busy?
4. Who is the customer, and what do they really want?
